user_direction: Keep BF16 and allow Windows shared system RAM: amend the memory limit, then benchmark speed and reliability.
purpose: Permit a separately registered Windows shared-memory feasibility benchmark while preserving the original failed resident-VRAM result.

memory_contract.superseded_for_new_benchmark_only: Peak CUDA allocation must fit within min(8 GiB, the physical device's dedicated memory).
memory_contract.new_contract: On the existing Windows desktop, CUDA tensor allocations may exceed dedicated VRAM and use Windows shared GPU system memory. The host remains the RTX 4060 Ti with 8 GB dedicated VRAM and 32 GB physical RAM through WSL2.
memory_contract.reporting: Report dedicated GPU residency, CUDA allocated and reserved peaks, Windows shared GPU memory with attribution limits, host physical memory and WSL memory/swap separately. A successful run under this amendment is not a resident-8GB-VRAM pass.
memory_contract.required_limits_before_execution: The new benchmark plan must register finite wall-time and memory stop limits before execution. Do not silently increase the existing WSL memory/swap settings or alter the driver's fallback policy.

unchanged.adapter_and_head: FP32; released parent adapter and pointer head; rank 16 and existing target modules
unchanged.detector_question_and_data_policy: Unchanged from the frozen registration and audited source policy.

benchmark_requirements: Write a new plan and separate output/report paths. Preserve every original Phase 4 report, handoff and model-lock byte.
Pin and record effective package/kernel versions. A training-kernel supplement must be explicit and validated on this GPU; keep Kev's inference-only fused serving path disabled.
Reuse the tokenizer-verified 2048-state-token hardware input shape and registered two-optimizer-step recipe. The repeated neutral hardware fixture is not detector training data or a corpus result.
Measure forward/backward, completed optimizer updates, finite gradients, actual adapter/head changes, checkpoint save and matching reload outputs.

Measure cold-start and training elapsed time, throughput, host RAM/swap and GPU memory. Report projection assumptions and uncertainty for the full trial grid rather than claiming production runtime from a tiny sample.
Run only one GPU model/job at a time and coordinate with the Phase 2 checker supervisor.

phase_status.phase_2: Independent pilot continues under its own frozen plan.
phase_status.phase_5: Blocked until the required data freeze, amended feasibility validation, and other registered study gates pass. The user's existing authorization to implement the study remains in effect; this amendment changes only the memory contract.
